notes.title: Guess Where Contest on Facebook
notes.content:
Panzarians,

Join on Facebook click [url=https://www.facebook.com/PanzarEU]here[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/719bda87d0015209b83d1e86b681d4436a1e10ae.jpg[/img]

Here we have a puzzles contest called "Guess Where". The essence of the competition is that fragments will be published of images of 4 gaming locations in the world of Panzar and you will have to guess all of these locations, and post the correct answer.
For convenience, each location was assigned a number (see list. Below), so your response should look like a sequence of numbers (for example: 1,2,3,14).

The contest will run for 5 days, the fastest player with the correct sequence will get 500 crystals, yes 500 crystals. If you not the fastest don't stop to put your posts, 2 random players will win 300 crystals each.

If nobody can guess the correct combination during the day since the start of the competition, the competition is completed. We will show you the correct answer, and the prize will be added to the prize pool of the next competition. Thus, in the next contest winner will take not 300 but 600 crystals or not 500 but 1000 crystals.

Non locations: 
1) Arena of Warlords 
2) Jungle Village 
3) Hall of Ancestors 
4) Dwarf Quarry 
5) Orc's Shrine 
6) Fortress Cannibals 
7) Orc Burgwall 
8) Siege of the Swamp Fort 
9) Cursed Altar 
10) Toxic Bay 
11) Expanse of Mists 
12) Alchemists Citadel 
13) Kromholm Mine 
14) Elven Pier
15) Snake Island Monastery
16) Combat School

Terms of the contest:
1) One account only one answer, so be careful and take your time. (edit or delete previous posts)
2) Every picture has a number 1 to 4 that is the order of you answer. 
3) Answers containing other information, other than Ingame Name - a combination of 4 numbers will not be considered. So if you want to write your opinion about the competition, or something else, put it in a separate comment. 
4) A combination consisting of less than or more than four numbers are not accepted. 
5) when you are a winner you will need to send your crystals division to esport@panzar.com

SO TO BE ABSOLUTELY CLEAR (1 line answer anything else will not be accepted) example: White Wolfs T - 3,6,16,5

notes.title: Update Coming soon
notes.content:
Panzarians, 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/9d14243dc61bb9f9c29f1021a6bc6b3c7861b079.jpg[/img]

Summer is the time of travel and discovery. That's why we at Panzar Studio are working hard to ensure that this summer you can go to unique, previously unknown places. Soon, a patch will be installed on the Panzar server, adding new locations for the PvP and PvE modes.

Do you hear? With a heavy ringing, the Iron Blacksmith's hammer descends on the anvil, linking behind the link creating the reasons for the war. A croak of Crom scrape with a shovel, burying treasure among the rocks, hoping that no one will ever get to his riches.

Mysterious creatures, called or created by dark sorcery, lie in wait for the travelers behind each turn, ready at any moment to rush into the attack. Here they believe only in steel and fire, they rely only on themselves and proven combat comrades. They do not expect favors from the gods, because the gods have long turned into monsters.

Yes, this world is full of dangers, but its map grows, becomes more extensive and more detailed, and real seekers of adventure can not stay at home at all - they are called for the threshold of untrod-den trails, picturesque spaces, the noise of battles and the shine of treasures. All this will be in abundance in the prepared locations, and we hope that you will appreciate them on their merits.

notes.title: Customization: Looks like not two looks are alike
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/0671d34490126d7eac5e059a950f528b4cf0e7c3.jpg[/img]

Customization in Panzar deals with a huge number of elements. All fragments of armor and weapons are displayed on a character. But, if that’s not enough, then there is always an opportunity to dress and paint your character exactly the way you want: choose freely from the long list of customization features that includes more than 200 different items.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/2979d51bc1fb0d69be157267888a47249b78c412.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/919d6756bbd4bc06db4d3f7ea9cb23c018662da8.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/26ccbf5738822d4f62ed7169aa1c15b6900acbe3.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/8b4038e6df3444f8a885dee6294d662d5d14f278.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/d278ae438e6fac3b2d84d93fb80a937fc8a538c7.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/9caa7d9918cd3672c8402d36f2f6c858e6abc2d3.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/671a59e83c613d0c753a72d6c3c75c2723b957a2.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/c2c6053635213878724090f79f950daec1ef4b2f.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/3de2b1d88831398a390ed6018b3b4c5f57f9f3c3.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/9d03a55f148cab9858ee1451a799c6a62bbe9181.jpg[/img][/url]

Costumes change completely the appearance of your character without affecting any combat parameters. Each thematic set consists of four elements: a hat, a weapon, a banner and a costume. All elements of different sets are combined with each other and can be painted. Witch hunter armed with an anchor or, perhaps, an old sea dog with a chain sword? Everything is possible.

notes.title: Big Start in USA
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/bc0e1a2812562e14394f2dcc56d5e490dd907322.jpg[/img]

Welcome, fellow adventurers!

The world of Panzar opened its doors to Americans. For the first time after several years of development, we are proud to present you with fierce team-based PvP and PvE battles, as well as intense E-sport tournaments. Decide whether you’ll use brute force, sophisticated mechanisms, powerful magic or will be in charge of allies’ health and well-being.

Create your own unique characters, develop and equip them as you like. Trade or upgrade weapons and armor any time between battles, find new friends or reconnect with the old ones! Gather teams, participate in tournaments, develop unique tactics and strategies for each of the game modes, create your own clans and fight shoulder to shoulder to reach victory!

Dynamic battles with a non-target combat system, outcome of which depends only on players’ skills, make every fight an unforgettable experience. Coordinate your actions with teammates so No Power in the Verse Can Stop you.

Panzar is a multiplayer session-based team action with a third person perspective, set in an original fantasy world where players fight each other on a variety of scenic PvP locations or go adventuring on vast, procedurally generated PvE maps.

notes.title: E-sport - Challenge everything
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5323408/0db403752780a52243723a49eef8df8dc289a1ff.jpg[/img]

Panzar is always a competition, always a fight, always a victory or a defeat. There is an elaborate, perfectly balanced tournament system in the game. It's time to try it out: in May, the first E-sport Panzar tournament will be held, the winners of which are going not only to write their names in the history of American Panzar but are also going to receive impressive prizes and memorable gifts.

A tournament, especially so significant, is always not only about entertainment but also about responsibility. Opponents are unlikely to give you any second chances and streams and live broadcasts will deliver every hit and every miss to a great lot of enthusiastic spectators. So start preparing now: gather your teams, distribute roles and responsibilities, train, consider different tactics and hone your skills to automatism. Remember: everyone can be a winner - in Panzar E-sport all have equal chances.

Here are some simple but important rules. Just bear them in mind. One can participate in a tournament only as a member of a team. To create a team, all its members must be in the same clan. There can be more than one team in a clan. Any team can challenge other teams to conduct training matches. Teams of the same clan can challenge each other.

notes.title: Update 44 : New Horizon
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761998.jpg[/img]

Upgrade №44 safely installed. All those who missed the previous brutal and horrible persons of their characters, rejoice! Faces, face and Hari returned to the original state and now they again can be frightening to young children hiccups and impressionable young men (which we strongly recommend you do not)! Of course, this does not concern persons beautiful elves, who chose to remain with the updated appearance. More information about these and other changes you can read in a special section on our website. Do not lose face, play PANZAR! 

Introduced a system of levels for a user account: with each new level increases the number of bonuses, including VIP-activated subscription. 
Account level depends on the amount purchased by the user crystals. 
Bonuses: 
Regular bonuses: 
• Additional experience accrued to all participants of the fight. The amount of experience depends on the level. 
• Discount when buying crystals. The size depends on the level. 
• Additional slots chests. The number of slots depends on the level. 
• Reset skills. 
• The ability to rename your character. 
• Gift for the character. 
• Gift for the account. 

Bonuses with active VIP-account: 
• Accelerated development of the character. It depends on the level. 
• Automatically improve things. 
• The chance to get a key from the large trunk. 
• Accelerated development of Weapons of Victory. It depends on the level. 
• The chance to get a key from Epic Chest. 
• Unlimited change of daily quests. 

Added special window VIP-level account that appears after clicking on the icon of the crystals. 
Purchase VIP-account can now be in the first section of the tab "Objects" in-game store. 
From the contents of a large trunk deleted object "Pearl Pendant". Now it is used as a unique gift for raising the level of your account. 
With an increase in the level of each account tied to it the character receives gifts. This also applies to newly created characters. 
At the character selection screen appears the "Gift characters", equipped with a special counter. When you click on the field, then the process of free creation of gift character level 30. Speed up the process you can use for maximizing account level. 
Icons indicating the account level are displayed in the following locations: 
• In standby table battle 
• The tab menu in action 
• In the frame profile 

Changed the mechanism of the VIP-akkaunta button in the main menu: 
• When you click on a player it moves to the store section "VIP-account" tab "Objects" 
• painted in orange, while not active with active VIP-account letters "VIP" - gray 
• Changed the icon VIP-account

notes.title: Patch 43 Recents Changes Summary
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/Content/images/patch.png[/img]

Patch 43.1
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug due to which a character did not receive experience for using the "Magical Shield" skill
[*]We fixed problems with the "awesomium" processes that caused the decline of performance and FPS
[*]A tablet with a message about low FPS now appears only when a really significant decrease of FPS occurs
[*]Fixed a bug due to which it was necessary to wait for the cooling of the cannon after installing the "Krom's Fiery Rage"
[/list]

Patch 43.2
[list]
[*]The amount of experience gained for applying the "Totem" skill is reduced by 10%
[*]Now the DoT-effect from the "Lacerated Wounds" ability is activated even if the victim is blocking at the moment of impact
[*]Fixed a bug due to which "Chimera Ash" affected bosses and minibosses at PvE locations
[*]The difficulty has been corrected on the Sunset Island (Hard) and Midnight Island (Very Hard) in the PvE mode
[*]Now, all players have a zero rating of Battle Value
[*]Now the number of Paladins in a team is limited to two
[*]We fixed a bug that prevented the opening of items available for crafting
[/list]
Patch 43.3
[list]
[*]There is some kind of makeup in the game. It's already available in the store, looks like a paper bag and can effectively hide the face of your character.
[*]Now character's health is reduced by 8% instead of 9% for 1 stack of the "Berserker Rage" skill
[/list]
Patch 43.4
[list]
[*]The amount of experience gained for the use of the "Siren Scream " ability has been reduced by 15%
[*]Now experience can be gained for healing an ally with the "Second Wind" skill
[*]Damage dealt by the Berserker's "Finishing Blow" has been increased by 5%
[*]The amount of experience gained for the use of the "Incense Of Quickening" ability has been increased by 15%
[*]The duration of the "Ring of Immortality" skill has been reduced from 10 to 8 seconds
[*]The "Ring of Immortality" radius has been reduced from 9.5 to 7.5 meters
[*]The range of the "Resurrection" skill has been reduced from 10.5 to 7.5 meters
[*]Recovery time for "Resurrection" has been increased from 45 to 60 seconds.
[*]The number of Will Points received for the use of the "Arquebus Mastery" skill has been reduced from 2 to 1
[*]The visual display for the "Battle Fervour" skill of Sister of Fire has been added
[*]We also fixed a bug due to which the characters who were under the effect of the "Seven-league Boots" skill, could not run on an enemy's Glare Ice
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the Incense Of Quickening did not increase the speed of the Paladin who used it
[/list]

[*]Fixed a bug due to which the experience for the use of Sapper's "Barrier" was counted wrongly

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 42
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[list]
[*]The maximum number of player in a group/party has been reduced from 8 to 3
[*]PvE mode has been completely redesigned, the size of a PvE party has reduced from 6 to 5 players
[*]Added a special chest, which can only be received on PvE locations
[*]A new type of tutorial has been added team against bots (for characters lvl 5-10)
[*]Introduction of Daily quests for both PvP and PvE modes
[*]Posebility to view broadcasts through the game client has been added
[*]New banners, emblems and accessories have been added
[*]Thematical thrones for the characters have been added, with a possibility to use them in battle.
[*]Numerical values now clearly show how much each parameter of an item is improved. You can seen it during the auto upgrade process.
[*]Decorative shields for Tanks and censers for Paladins have been added
[*]Now the equipment items (including bottles of elixirs and banners) do not interact with a character. They will not interfere with characters' movements or the construction of dwarven constructions
[*]Skills, such as "Glare Ice," "Sky Fire" and "Holy Fire", from allies are highlighted in blue and the effects of corresponding from the enemy skills - in red
[*]Access to a large number of previously inaccessible places on different maps is much easier now
[*]Now you can remove the "basic ability" from the slot on the HUD-panel and replace it with any other skill on a player's choice.
[*]When receiving a medal for the successful completion of a PvE it will brings a player some loot
[*]Now you can change abilities during the battle without waiting for the death of a character
[*]We've changed prizes for the Wheel Of the Four Gods: amulets will be replaced by keys for standard chests in an amountfrom one to five, depending on the number of days in a row played by a user [/list]

Skills & Abilities:

Ice Witch:                                                          
[list]                                                                                                                                     
[*]The aiming mechanism of the "Winter Cold" skill has been changed - now the Ice Witch freezes enemies only in front of her
[*]But we've added opportunity to move around while using the "Winter Cold" ability
[*]The amount of energy required for the use of the ability to "Frozen Sphere" has been reduced from 15 to 1 units
[*]And yes, we've added opportunity to move around while using the "Frozen Sphere" skill
[*]Amount of class points for a successful hit by the "Frozen Orb" has been reduced by 15%
[*]We've changed the "Second Wind" skill - no the Ice Witch regenerates herself and allies who are in close proximity
[*]Now the "Siren Scream" ability inflicts damage on frozen mechanisms
[*]The amount of energy needed to activate the "Freeze" ability, has been reduced from 20 to 15 units [/list]

Sister Of Fire:
                                       
[list]
[*]The "Meditation" ability has been removed
[*]Instead, we've added new skill "Battle Fervor" - Sister Of Fire significantly increases her attack speed, at the same time reducing the damage done
[*]Also, we've changed skill "Second Wind" - now Sister Of Fire regenerates herself and allies who are in close proximity
[*]And yes, we've added opportunity to move around while using "Fireball"

notes.content:
Panzarians,

As said Gror Krivoborodiy, The Empires of the Deep chief martial carpenters , sit - better than standing and it is difficult not to agree with him. However, any self-respecting warrior knows that the most important thing is to what exactly you sit. He sat down on a stump on the way to Grandma's or on a bench in the park, you are unlikely to provide the respect of others. Get down on the body of the defeated enemy in the middle of the field of battle - well, it might find some understanding among the Orcs, but the rest, probably not appreciate. And the pants got dirty. Portable camp chair is good for Napoleon, surveying the battle through a telescope, but it is not suitable for smelling blood, sweat and gunpowder gladiators Panzar, that forged his victory in the midst of battle.

That is why designers [i]Panzar Studio[/i] and developed for you three unique throne. This magnificent, original buildings, each of which corresponds to one of the themed costume sets. Judges of the Supreme Throne is perfect for any witch hunters, filled with the power to issue new sentences, reminds his grim, spartan beauty that in the harsh and unforgiving world, there should be no witchcraft. Throne Late Captain instantly make fighter Salt Brotherhood recall the gloomy cabin, swaying deck underfoot, creaking Ventoux over his head and the moon gleams on the blades rebel command. Who knows, maybe under his padded hidden treasure map (actually, none)? Thone "Grand technocrat" - elegant and ornate must-have for each of the Free Mechanics. This is a great proof of the victory over the mind with mysticism, the triumph of technology over the primitive beliefs and incantations.

[IMG]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761911.jpg[/IMG]

Thrones are ready and will appear in the game from day to day, will break on PANZAR server in the ranks of the long-awaited and large-scale [i]"Updates №42"[/i]. We hope they will become a welcome addition to the lineup themed outfits and accessories will bring variety to the gameplay. Stay tuned to look for the throne to their liking, obtain victory after victory and prepare for an even more unusual news - all the fun in PANZAR just begun!

P.S. There will be one throne, but we will tell about it separately.

notes.title: Announcement Patch 41 - Scheduled for 27th Jun
notes.content:
Panzarains,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761847.jpg[/img]

Attention! [b]Next Monday, June 27[/b] will be released long-awaited update №41! 

Therefore PANZAR server will be temporarily unavailable - [b][i]update installation will begin at 08:00 Moscow time[/i][/b] and may take several hours. We apologize for any inconvenience.

To make it less of a waiting there will be a live broadcast on RU website with Dmitry Morozov "AriOrH" he will respond to questions relating to fresh changes in the project. 

In the meantime - you, my friends, are going to see the former PANZAR and be prepare for the great changes! Stay tuned!

Note's
[list]

[*]The parameters for mana and energy have been combined into a single parameter - called energy.
[*]When using spells or abilities you will consume energy.
[*]Purple Energie runes will now increase the max energy you can have.
[*]Yellow Will Rune will increase the maximum Will value and will also generate Will.
[*]Reworked all ability that influenced mana - now all ability is working on energy.
[*]Blue elixir now restores energy.
[*]Yellow elixirs added five point Will.
[*]The logic of mana "Energy" abilities has been changed. When you run out of energy you do NOT automatically switched to the weapons.
[*]U can use block, while using Ranged Weapon
[*]Now you can turn off voice notifications in battle
[*]Added a cool down for emotions
[*]Weapons and banners of dead characters disappear after 15 seconds previously it was 30 sec.
[*]Players that are on your ignore list can't trigger an invitation to clans, friends or groups.
[*]Now, the notification about the invitation of a character to a group is displayed in the system channel
[*]After the capture of a control point on the Siege mode maps the defense will respond faster than the attacking team.
[*]We added health bars for structures (in yellow) and characters (in red)
[*]Added the opportunity to drop off all upgrades that you have put on items.
[*]The "party" system has been changed: now the difference in the characters level cannot be more than five levels
[*]From now on all configuration files will be encrypted and repackaged, this will make it impossible to use the user's own .cfg files
[*]Costumes have been added to the game: "Witch Hunter", "Free mechanic", "Salt brotherhood."
[*] The lock "Play" button has been added for players leaving the fight before it ends. The more often you desert your comrades in battle, the longer he/she has to wait for the opportunity to participate in the next.
[*]Added a new resource - the "Essence of Chaos" - from which you can create chests.
[*]Added the ability to change any resource into the resource "Essence of Chaos."
[*]Also added to the game are custom trophies, custom weapons, new costumes, banners and stickers.
[*]Leveling character to level 5 is now carried out on the training locations with bots as allies and enemy.
[*]Added effects of injuries: while reducing the amount of HP to the point when the character starts to limp, the screen darkens, the image becomes whitish. If desired, these effects can be disabled in the menu.
[*]Added switchable tips, explaining the reasons cannot be executed or that ability.
[*]Change the angle of the camera when using the Gunners ability "Barrel Rap."
[*]The term "memory" used by the player's ability or action (attack, movement, ability, etc.) is reduced to two seconds.
[*]Changed parameters of many abilities.
[*]Strips of energy and the effects do now have a purple color.
[*]The ability cool down strips have been moved below the key text.
[*]Added option to block all incoming invitations to the clans, friendship, and group.
[*]Animation when craft can now be skipped with the Enter \ Esc key
[*]Any pop-up window can now be closed with a click outside the active window.
[*]Added option to adjust the sensitivity of the mouse.
[*]Put in option enable / disable texture streaming.

Changes on locations:
[*]Added new PvP-map "Iron Trail".
[*]On the "Cannibal Stronghold" map the location of the boxes used to build a portable respawn has been changed.
[*]Recovery time for a portable respawn on "Cannibal Stronghold" after its destruction is reduced from 120 to 60 seconds
[*]On the "Elven Pier" map the disturbed bees stop attacking characters that have only 1HP left; also when the inquisitor is going into "Invisibility", the bees buff is going off him.
[*]Also we've denied access to a lot of places where a character could "get stuck"
[*]Reduced damage caused by stationary cannons on the "Alchemists' Citadel" map

Changes to skills:
[*]The aiming mechanism changed, the aiming no display operational range of the skill.
[*]For the range skills, the parabola line has been removed (with the exception of the core).
[*]Changed the required number of embedded talents to explore the different initial levels of abilities.
[*]Reduced speed getting class Points when Sisters of Fire and Paladin use skills.

Berserker:
[*]Added passive ability called "Green Fury" increases the attack speed with 10%.
[*]The ability to "Battle Rage" is replaced by the ability to "Battle Fervor" now restores some health and cost energy.
[*]The ability to "Sneaky Punch" will take 50 energy and for a short period it will prohibits the use of "Sprint" skill.
[*]The cost of "Vortex of War" skills changed and is now 50 points will.
[*]When using the Skill "Berserker Rage" two icons will be displayed. The first will shows how much energy is left to know when it will allow you to gain stacks again. The second shows the number of stacks
[*]Now, the "Berserker Rage" skills can be activated during the characters' movement

Tank:
[*]The number of levels required to unlock skill "Damage Reflection" has been reduced from 3 to 2.
[*]The number of levels needed to unlock, "Chain" ability is reduced from 3 to 2.
[*]The skill Magic Shield - now consumes energy from incoming damage.
[*]The number of levels needed to unlock, "Magic Shield" skill level 2 has been increased to 3.
[*]The equipment of the Tank has been rebalanced, now the maximum Mastery of Tanks is equal with those of other classes and is about 7751
[*]Cool down of the "Chain" ability has been increased from 5 to 10 seconds

[*]After the capture of a control point on the Siege mode maps the defense will respond faster than the attacking team.

[*]Added the opportunity to drop off all upgrades that you have put on items.
[*]The "party" system has been changed: now the difference in the characters level cannot be more than five levels

notes.title: EU server in Europe 21th Apr
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://i.imgbox.com/5KY32GSI.jpg[/img]

Smale announcement. Tomorrow morning 21th Apr the EU server will be moved from the Russian server room to the European Server room.

This means that only for Europe that the server will not be available. The move is planned to start at 6:00 am CET and can take 2 to 4 hours.

What can you expect.
1) Tournament will be on the EU server with an EU connection I already did test and my ping in Belgium, when I'm playing, is between 1ms and 25ms (current server I'm between 80ms and 110ms) So Tomorrow the Tournament will be on the EU server.

2) Clan battle will be on EU server with an EU connection same as Tournaments.

3) Public Games matchmaking will try in the 1st 60 sec to put as much EU player together following the matchmaking rules. If not enough players are found for the match, then it will be move to the RU server and RU players will be added to the match. The match will be played on the RU server (this is with current speed). So in theory if you create multiple balanced EU groups of 8 players you should end up fight against each other on EU server. More EU players online more chance on EU match on EU server.

Note: As live test the NA server has been use, NA server is already located in a NA server room. The server is up and running without issues. The only thing missing is population.

notes.title: SuperVIP -50% coming to an End
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761704.jpg[/img]

Friends! If you are planning to buy a [b]Super VIP[/b] at [b]half the cost[/b], but for some reason did not manage to do that, then Hurry - you have [b]a couple of days left[/b]. Already on Thursday, February 4th, the price of an annual subscription will revert to its standard, the generally accepted value of 3,000 crystals. Do not miss the chance to provide a premium for the entire 2016 with a discount of 50%.

What SuperVIP? This is a special status for the most loyal players Panzar, which ensures the most comfortable when playing the game. For SuperVIP on your account should the total number of 365 (or more) days normal "premium."

What do you personally get as a bonus, and which will it bring to your team?

First, regardless of whether they have active Premium subscription or not, all players with the status SuperVIP can create runes and charms with the chance of success set at 100%. For you will no longer be options - always a guaranteed success.

Secondly, SuperVIP open access to a special banner and avatar. Be careful! Currently you can get this bonus just for one character, but we plan to in the future to bring happiness to all your characters.

Thirdly, SuperVIP bring you twice the experience, gold and resources for the fight than with the usual "premium."

Finally, by their presence in the session, for each SuperVIP holder the Experience gained is increased for all participants in the battle by 5%.

notes.title: Guess Where Contest II - Between 15th Jan and 21th Jan
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976721426.jpg[/img]

Here we are return of the weekly puzzles contest called [b]"Guess Where"[/b]. The essence of the competition is that at a certain time  fragments will be published of images of four gaming locations world Panzar. (date and time of the start of the competition will be announced in advance, at least one day before the start of the competition) . And you will have to guess all of these locations, and post the correct answer.
For convenience, each location we assigned a number (see list. Below), so your response should look like a sequence of numbers (for example: 1,2,3,14).

The contest will run until [b]21th Jan 2015 12:00 CET[/b] or until the moment when the 3 correct answer are in.
The First 3, that give the answer with the correct number combination and will be our winner! The prize -  500/300/100 crystals .

If [b]nobody[/b] can guess the correct combination during the day since the start of the competition, the competition is completed. We will [b]show[/b] you the correct answer, and the prize will be added to the prize pool of the [b]next competition[/b]. Thus, in the next contest winner will take not 100 but 200 crystals or not 500 but 1000 crystals.

[i]Non locations: 
1) Arena of Warlords 
2) Jungle Village 
3) Fire Cauldron Valley 
4) Hall of Ancestors 
5) Dwarf Quarry 
6) Orc's Shrine 
7) Fortress Cannibals / Monkey Hill 
8) Meteor Hunt 
9) Orc Burgwall 
10) Siege of the Swamp Fort 
11) Cursed Altar 
12) Chimera Garden 
13) Toxic Bay 
14) Expanse of Mists 
15) Temple of Sandstorms 
16) Alchemists Citadel 
17) Kromholm Mine 
18) Elven Pier
19) Snake Island Monastery
20) Combat School
21) City of Idols
[/i]

Terms of the contest:
1) One account only one answer, so be careful and take your time. 
2) To post a response wait until you see the pieces. 
3) Answers containing other information, other than Ingame Name - a combination of four numbers will not be considered. So if you want to write your opinion about the competition, or something else, put it in a separate comment. 
4) a combination consisting of less than or more than four digits are not accepted. 

Post on the Forum [url=http://forum.panzar.com/posting.php?mode=edit&f=4&p=223411]here[/url]

Restart Guess Where Contest - Between 9th and 14th Jan
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976721426.jpg[/img]

Here we are return of the weekly puzzles contest called [b]"Guess Where"[/b]. The essence of the competition is that at a certain time  fragments will be published of images of four gaming locations world Panzar. (date and time of the start of the competition will be announced in advance, at least one day before the start of the competition) . And you will have to guess all of these locations, and post the correct answer.
For convenience, each location we assigned a number (see list. Below), so your response should look like a sequence of numbers (for example: 1,2,3,14).

Check and play for info on Forum [url=http://forum.panzar.com/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=14054]here[/url]

The contest will run until [b]14th Jan 2015 12:00 CET[/b] or until the moment when the 3 correct answer are in.
The First 3, that give the answer with the correct number combination and will be our winner! The prize -  500/300/100 crystals .

If [b]nobody[/b] can guess the correct combination during the day since the start of the competition, the competition is completed. We will [b]show[/b] you the correct answer, and the prize will be added to the prize pool of the [b]next competition[/b]. Thus, in the next contest winner will take not 100 but 200 crystals or not 500 but 1000 crystals.

[i]Non locations: 
1) Arena of Warlords 
2) Jungle Village 
3) Fire Cauldron Valley 
4) Hall of Ancestors 
5) Dwarf Quarry 
6) Orc's Shrine 
7) Fortress Cannibals / Monkey Hill 
8) Meteor Hunt 
9) Orc Burgwall 
10) Siege of the Swamp Fort 
11) Cursed Altar 
12) Chimera Garden 
13) Toxic Bay 
14) Expanse of Mists 
15) Temple of Sandstorms 
16) Alchemists Citadel 
17) Kromholm Mine 
18) Elven Pier
19) Snake Island Monastery
20) Combat School
21) City of Idols
[/i]
Terms of the contest:
1) One account only one answer, so be careful and take your time. 
2) To post a response wait until you see the pieces. 
3) Answers containing other information, other than Ingame Name - Zone - a combination of four numbers will not be considered. So if you want to write your opinion about the competition, or something else, put it in a separate comment. 
4) a combination consisting of less than or more than four digits are not accepted. 

SO TO BE ABSOLUTELY CLEAR (1 line answer anything else will not be accepted)

White Wolfs T - EU - 3,6,16,5

notes.title: Silver League Season VII
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[IMG]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761690.jpg[/IMG]

In these dark and bloody days on the battlefield, we fight this never ending war in the name of our gods. For humans, orcs, elves and dwarfs, battle is the most magnificent competition in which our races can be indulge. It brings out all that is best, it removes all that is base. 
Zar wants to share this with the young warriors, the general who wins the battle makes many calculations in his temple before the battle is fought. The general who loses makes but few calculations beforehand.

The 6th season has come to pass, we start with a new season, we had Kill La Kill that came to battle and overcame all challenges the battle against the team of Gold league was forfeited. This season we have Wariors joining us on Silver, they will have to overcome all challenge and get to the first place to regain their place in Gold League.

Total Prize pot every week is 7000 crystals. 

Follow all information of upcoming tournaments [url=http://www.panzar.com/en/tournaments]Here[/url]

notes.title: Gold League Season VII
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[IMG]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976761688.jpg[/IMG]

Zar wants you to know the following. Whenever death may surprise us, let it be welcome, if our battle cry has reached even one receptive ear and another hand reaches out to take up our arms. Then it had meaning. 
Every war has a strategy here is one that has been proven over and over again, carry the battle to them. Don't let them bring it to you. Put them on the defensive and don't ever apologize for anything.

In this seventh season of the Golden League we welcome the team Family from clan Exclusive who is still first place in 6st Season, they has shown great battle strategy, we also have team RageQuit from Clan -Disorder- who took 2nd place they have a great fighting spirit. We go on with our list and name team First Legion from Clan United Legion who fought for that 3th place and they are for sure not lacking any courage on the battlefield and last but not least we have team Kill la Kill from Clan Unsung they prevailed there battle against First Legion from clan United Legions they have provide use with the inspiration to go for the top.

Let the next season begin with glorias battles. Total prize winnings is 53000 crystals.

Four Teams will fight.
1st round: Team 1 vs Team 2 and Team 3 vs Team 4 
2nd round: Team 2 vs Team 4 and Team 1 vs Team 3 
3th round: Team 1 vs Team 4 and Team 2 vs Team 3

notes.content:
Panzarians,

Winter is at the door a cold wind was blowing from the north, and it made the trees rustle like living things. 

Some say “Winter is the time for comfort, for good food and warmth, for the touch of a friendly hand and for a talk beside the fire: it is the time for home.” 

In Panzar we go on battle after battle proving our worth we go back to the 8 vs 8 with a cold chill on our backs.

notes.title: Green Hunter - A good Hunter
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976751656.jpg[/img]

[i]Witch Hunt[/i] - a very exciting and interesting to do, popular at all times and in all corners of the continent PANZAR. There is nothing surprising in the fact that it has found adherents among the inhabitants of the jungle [i]Ru [/i]Arkham. What is the orc do not like good hunting ?! Also, keep in mind the eternal hostility to the green-skinned barbarians magic, witchcraft and to the rest incomprehensible murmur. Of course, they themselves are in full combat volshboy shamans, but first go and Defeat of the shaman - with witches, the situation is quite different: there is nothing easier than to race with clubs at the ready for the half-naked beauties. And then they're so funny chirping at the stake ...

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976751657.jpg[/img]

However, to get into the ranks of the ordinary young Orc Hunter is not too easy. One only strength and skill for this little, instructors require high moral character, dedication, ability to read ancient texts and occult magic to understand the symbolism. Of course, most powerful and fanged candidates is eliminated immediately, without waiting until the end of this list. Among the remaining large part simply does not understand what they say, but because of force necessary to withdraw. But certainly those who are willing to learn and master unfamiliar swamp dweller skills are very valuable professionals.Feral power and fury, combined with more or less developed intelligence make them true masters, whose names recall witches heart and say with genuine hatred.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976751658.jpg[/img]

As for the costumes, the orcs, become a witch hunter, usually try to comply with the dress code - as can, of course, on your own savage manner. Some find it funny and even absurd, but have not yet found the daredevil that would dare to express their views orc hunter in the face. However, they say, was one dwarf Kromholme designer, a tailor at the Principal level, is well versed in the latest fashion trends - that he allegedly once joked ominously over the green-dressed as a witch hunter, who came into his shop for a cut of black cloth. Nobody knows exactly what it was a joke. Shop the same night was burned, along with all the cut and cloth, and dwarf designer disappeared. The intrigues of dark forces, not otherwise ...

notes.title: Leaving Games
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976741584.jpg[/img]

Well, it's time to talk about those who do not justify the high rank of " PANZAR warrior ". The unenlightened person leaving the game sessions, thereby summing teammates and breaking the course of the battle - that he was talking about. Of course, everyone can be in a situation where he would need to urgently get out of the game: the mere fact that "Lebanon" is not yet worthy of condemnation. But if you do it too often, clearly abusing the inconvenience and delivering a huge number of other players, you can earn a punishment.

For this Panzar created a report to find these players faster.

On Russian server 11 players got punished for three weeks. Apart from these, the ban for one week went to other people - a total of more than a hundred - who also left the game sessions too often, though not in such quantities. On this we all. Respect yourself, allies and rivals, soberly assess their capabilities and try not to get out of a fight to the end.

PS: I will do my first scan for EU player that have left more then 50% of the games will get a ban from the game for 1 week and current scan from monday until today already give me 3 eu players.

notes.title: Show Your Team Contest I - From 18th to 27th Aug
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731565.jpg[/img]

Here we are a brand new contest called [b]"Show Your Team"[/b]. The essence of the competition is to create a team picture. This is a team and clan contest you will need 9 members of 1 Clan to make this possible. What is required I want a pic with 8 members of 1 team in the center of the screen on a map of your choice.

The contest will run until [b]27th aug 2015 12:00 CET[/b], I will evaluate the pictures and choose 1 winning team that will receive 1800 crystals for there efforts.

Join on forum [url=http://forum.panzar.com/viewforum.php?f=4]here[/url]

Terms of the contest:
- Make a decent picture of your team. (I do NOT ! want to see a team picture without armor)
- All post and pic will be posted on forum. 

What exactly you need to do:
1) Make a screenshot in very high quality at highest possible resolution. (only the person that is taking the screenshot needs to use these settings)
2) 8 members need to be clear in image 
3) Make sure the banners are not visible 
4) Make sure the player that takes the pic is not in the screenshot.
5) You can dress/color with any kind of armor you want, at the moment of screenshot you can be creative and jump or use emotion like you want so make it unique. (I mean a picture of 8 laughing members is allowed)
6) Photoshop is allowed.

Practical approach:
1) Create clan battle of 1 vs 8 of the map of your choice.
2) The 1 player needs to exit battle and join the 8 so it is 0vs9. (this will remove the banners in the back of the chars)
3) Find the location together and take up position.
4) The player that is taking the pic needs to zoom in to max and use the laughing emotion. When your char is laughing on the ground you need to take the screenshot. (this will remove the screenshot taker from the image)

You can use [url]http://imgbox.com/[/url] ot upload and post you pic to this tread.

notes.title: Free Mechanics, You asked? We answer!
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731552.jpg[/img]

Just the other day we told you about the costume and the history of "free mechanics". Now is the time to look at the costumes of people following through steel and steam, as well as to answer the most pressing questions regarding the new system of customization of your characters.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731553.jpg[/img]

[b]- Will the suit sold for crystals?[/b]
﻿No. Buy a suit for crystals you can not. 
[b]- Will it be possible to create a costume? [/b]
﻿No. Create a costume will not be. 
[b]- How do I get a suit? [/b]
﻿First, the costumes will be available as a prize for special game events. For example, the winners of the "Great Four ﻿Tournament of the people" will be the first owners of the new items. Second, you could win a suit in the "Wheel of the Four ﻿Gods." We have already said that the "Wheel" will soon change radically for the better: the prizes will become much more ﻿attractive. 
[b]- Will Suit "witch hunters" is only available Inquisitors? [/b]
﻿No. Booths available for all four races of the world Panzar.Of course, the costumes in a single series, for example, "Free ﻿Mechanics" are slightly different to meet specific appearance of each race, but share common elements and style.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731554.jpg[/img]

[b]- How many parts are new costumes consist of?[/b]
﻿The main elements of the costumes consist of two pieces: the head and torso. However, all plans to add four new slots for ﻿customization: head, torso, banner and talismans. About banners and mascots we will tell you in detail. 
[b]- Such a wide variety of costumes will not lead to the emergence of "lag"? [/b]
﻿Do not worry. Even if all the participants in the battle will use costumes - it does not affect performance. We found a great ﻿solution that completely solved the problem.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731555.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Free Mechanics Society
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731550.jpg[/img]

"Free Mechanics" were once secret society, whose main purpose is to gain world domination through technology. Their doctrine included the complete rejection of magic in favor of science and rational thought. They kept a closely guarded secret of his inventions, ready to begin full-scale war against the magicians and even the four gods - but the night of madness and the ensuing global cataclysms thwarted their plans. Moreover, the main ideologists of the plot - the dwarf Glock Us Copper and alchemist Yargraf half dead - were happily devoured one of said-In the Dark. It proved once and for all the rest of society that magic and technology must exist in peace and harmony.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731537.png[/img]

Since then, the "Free Mechanics" lead lives of ordinary mercenaries and adventurers. No global plans, no great ideas. Moreover, not so long ago, they began to accept into their ranks even magicians - Sisters of Fire, Frost Witch, Inquisitors and Paladins. Anyone can apply, undergo the rite of initiation (including the exam to use a wrench) and muttering unintelligible oath (which contains words such as "Notch" or "pulse width modulation") to become the proud owner of mechanical limbs and stylish glasses-Goggle . Also included is attached to malfunction of the internal organs. For example, orcs somehow often suffers heart - it is necessary to replace the steam engine to the eternal, and people with respiratory problems begin in ways that are solved with the help of special pumps.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731538.png[/img]

"Free mechanics" can without doubt be called trendsetters in the continent Panzar. Artificial body parts and outlandish costumes always attract the eye, are a cause for envy and discussions. But it also comes responsibility. Cylinders, caps, coats coattails, graceful canes - all this requires appropriate manners and rules of behavior. Neither the Free mechanic never allow himself to discuss the Honourable parent opponent even during the heaviest battle - and never will submit its steel arm to anyone who decides to such baseness. Grieve not the Free Tinker, be polite on the battlefields PANZAR!Bonus:

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731539.png[/img]

notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731500.jpg[/img]

Ok here you have it, Zar, Yordrag and Himera challenge you again. Prove you have it in you to be at the front line of this war. 

Once we have a war there is only one thing to do. It must be won. For defeat brings worse things than any that can ever happen in war. 


The prizes:

[b]1st place: 1200 crystals
2nd place: 900 crystals
3rd place: 600 crystals[/b]

What you have to do:

Get into teams, stream your PvE match and [b]post it to the forum[/b] . After closing we will watch and check your submissions. [b]The 3 fastest teams will receive crystals.[/b] Please read the rules and post, all the information needs to be on your forum thread. Remember no stream or incomplete information, no crystals!

Forum Post is [url=http://forum.panzar.com/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=13733]here[/url]

[b]Target:[/b]

- PvE Map “Fire Cauldron Valley”
- Difficulty mode "Hard"
- Fastest time
- Class Choice is yours to choose

[b]The rules:[/b]

You must stream and post the stream on our forum thread. This stream must show:
- Player names at beginning of match*
- Player names at end of match*
- Capture all waypoints
- For second entry 50% of team needs to be different.
- All player must be EU accounts

On your forum post, please include this information:
- Link to stream
- Start and end time of fastest battle streamed (just in case the stream has more than one battle)
- Character names of team

*The team must have the same players at the start and end!

PS: The post will be locked on 12th Jul at 23:00 CET until a winner has been selected.

notes.title: Mad Crafting: Fury Forge Weekend
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731494.jpg[/img]

Approaching new holiday - [b]Panzar[/b] - which means it is time again for the great summer stock! Long before the Last Mora, in the heyday of - [b]the Empire Deep gnomes[/b] - , bearded little man often held large fairs, which attracted thousands of merchants from all over the world. 

The best masters competed with each other, creating real works of art. Since then, much water has flowed under the bridge, the world had to go through several devastating disasters, a lot of tournaments, updates and patches - and now, all of a sudden, a group of dwarves, - [b]led Yovarom nicknamed Wet Gunpowder[/b] - , decided to restore the glorious tradition piedmont blacksmiths. 

The event will be held from Friday to Monday morning. Bring your resources to the forge, and there you will make of them whatever you want. - [b]Forget about 40%[/b] - the true masters do not allow misfires and mistakes! The absolute guarantee of success! Only this weekend - and only PANZAR!

notes.title: Last Guess Where Contest VII - Between 3th Jul and 9th Jul
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976721426.jpg[/img]

Here we are a brand new puzzles weekly contest called [b]"Guess Where"[/b]. The essence of the competition is that at a certain time  fragments will be published of images of four gaming locations world Panzar. (date and time of the start of the competition will be announced in advance, at least one day before the start of the competition) . And you will have to guess all of these locations, and post the correct answer.
For convenience, each location we assigned a number (see list. Below), so your response should look like a sequence of numbers (for example: 1,2,3,14).

The contest will run until [b]9th Jul 2015 12:00 CET[/b] or until the moment when the 3 correct answer are in.
The First 3, that give the answer with the correct number combination and will be our winner! The prize -  500/300/100 crystals .

If [b]nobody[/b] can guess the correct combination during the day since the start of the competition, the competition is completed. We will [b]show[/b] you the correct answer, and the prize will be added to the prize pool of the [b]next competition[/b]. Thus, in the next contest winner will take not 100 but 200 crystals or not 500 but 1000 crystals.

[i][b]- Images will be posted Sunday 5th Jul between 7:00 and 12:00 -[/b][/i]

The images will be posted [url=http://forum.panzar.com/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=13716]here[/url]

[i]Non locations: 
1) Arena of Warlords 
2) Jungle Village 
3) Fire Coldron Valley 
4) Hall of Ancesters 
5) Dwarf Quarry 
6) Orcs Shrine 
7) Fortress Cannibals / Monkey Hill 
8) Meteor Hunt 
9) Orc Burgwall 
10) Siege of the Swamp Fort 
11) Cursed Altar 
12) Chimera Garden 
13) Toxic Bay 
14) Expanse of Mists 
15) Temple of Sandstorms 
16) Alchemists Citadel 
17) Kromholm Mine 
18) Elven Pier
[/i]
Terms of the contest:
1) One account only one answer, so be careful and take your time. 
2) To post a response wait until you see the pieces. 
3) Answers containing other information, other than Ingame Name - Zone - a combination of four numbers will not be considered. So if you want to write your opinion about the competition, or something else, put it in a separate comment. 
4) a combination consisting of less than or more than four digits are not accepted. 

SO TO BE ABSOLUTE CLEAR (1 line answer anything else will not be accepted)

White Wolfs T - EU - 3,6,16,5

notes.title: Burnings at the stake in the Horizon
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731472.jpg[/img]

Character Customization in PANZAR goes to a new level: soon the game will have themed gear. And today we are pleased to present to you the first of them - a set called "Witch Hunter" . Hunters are a special division of the Order of Paladins, created to fight the Shadows mushers and their followers. A few decades ago they were the terror of the inhabitants in the Three Kingdoms and the surrounding areas. Their blades do not spared either worshiped Chimera warlocks, nor do they spare harmless village quack. It was said, though they are adopting methods of their enemies and  turn themselves to Faceless Goddess. Anyway, after the defeat of the sect mushers, there was no need for Shadow Hunters and the organization was disbanded.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731470.png[/img]

However, to this day they and out there, out of nowhere they appear, darkest forces soldiers in long coats and typical hats - and none of those know from whom they came, none came back to tell us what they needed. If you practice the forbidden magic, or make a sacrifice to Chimera or keep secret from everyone in the basement about the last instance of the "Book of Shadows," be prepared for that day - most likely, during the full moon - will knock at your door hand in black leather glove. 

Package "Witch Hunter", as well as all subsequent ones, will be available to any character, regardless of class, race and gender. Of course, some differences still there: for example, the option for a much sleeker elves that are orcs and dwarf costume is much shorter man.But the main defining features remain unchanged, a common theme - and now any of you will be able to try on a garment sinister fighter with evil spirits.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976731471.png[/img]

In the near future we will talk about other, equally interesting sets of equipment, which affect a wide range of topics, from steampunk pirate to romance - hope every player will find something here to your liking. Besides, it is not far off the time in the tournament will be visible battle commands, each of which will not just painted in custom colors, and dressed in the same style. Keep an eye, Costumizations, play PANZAR!

notes.title: Guess Where Contest VI - Between 26th Jun and 2th Jul
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media2.axd/281474976721426.jpg[/img]

Here we are a brand new puzzles weekly contest called [i][b]"Guess Where"[/b][/i]. The essence of the competition is that at a certain time  fragments will be published of images of four gaming locations world Panzar. (date and time of the start of the competition will be announced in advance, at least one day before the start of the competition) . And you will have to guess all of these locations, and post the correct answer.
For convenience, each location we assigned a number (see list. Below), so your response should look like a sequence of numbers (for example: 1,2,3,14).

The contest will run until [i][b]2th Jul 2015 12:00 CET[/b][/i] or until the moment when the 3 correct answer are in.
The First 3, that give the answer with the correct number combination and will be our winner! The prize -  500/300/100 crystals .

If [i][b]nobody[/b][/i] can guess the correct combination during the day since the start of the competition, the competition is completed. We will [i][b]show[/b][/i] you the correct answer, and the prize will be added to the prize pool of the [i][b]next competition[/b][/i]. Thus, in the next contest winner will take not 100 but 200 crystals or not 500 but 1000 crystals.

[i]Non locations: 
1) Arena of Warlords 
2) Jungle Village 
3) Fire Coldron Valley 
4) Hall of Ancesters 
5) Dwarf Quarry 
6) Orcs Shrine 
7) Fortress Cannibals / Monkey Hill 
8) Meteor Hunt 
9) Orc Burgwall 
10) Siege of the Swamp Fort 
11) Cursed Altar 
12) Chimera Garden 
13) Toxic Bay 
14) Expanse of Mists 
15) Temple of Sandstorms 
16) Alchemists Citadel 
17) Kromholm Mine 
18) Elven Pier
[/i]
Terms of the contest:
1) One account only one answer, so be careful and take your time. 
2) To post a response wait until you see the pieces. 
3) Answers containing other information, other than Ingame Name - Zone - a combination of four numbers will not be considered. So if you want to write your opinion about the competition, or something else, put it in a separate comment. 
4) a combination consisting of less than or more than four digits are not accepted. 

SO TO BE ABSOLUTE CLEAR (1 line answer anything else will not be accepted)

White Wolfs T - EU - 3,6,16,5

notes.title: Server Maintanance - 19th May
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media.axd/281474976711215[/img]

Server maintenance for patch 37.1 will start on 19th may 2015 at 6:00 CET


Patchnote:
- Fixed a bug that led to the game shutdown in the "Back to the 90s" mode
- Experience gained over the use of "Krom Punch" has been reduced by 30%
- Experience gained over the use of "Chain Grenade" has been reduced by 50%
- The cost of the "Plague" ability has changed: at the first level, it has increased from 30 to 40 class points, at level 2 - from 25 to 35 class points, and on 3 level - from 20 to 30 class points
- The cooldown duration of "Gravity" has been increased from 15 to 30 seconds
- The working radius of "Shockwave" has been reduced from 4.5 to 3.3 meters
- Damage inflicted by skills "Cannon" and "Tesla Pole" has been increased by 1%
- The limit for the Berserker characters in one game session has been set. From now on no more than two of them are allowed per team.
- "Cleansing" now cancels the “Laceration” ability of the Inquisitor.

notes.title: Recreational Geography
notes.content:
Ladies & gentlemen!

[IMG]http://www.panzar.com/_media.axd/281474976721393[/IMG]

We are immensely proud to show the First, Full and Only Map of the Panzar continent! Best cartographers and artists of our time and space crafted it – specially for you! Let us have a small excursion through those lands of glory and never-ending war, let us learn a little about home of never-ending heroes.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media.axd/281474976721395[/img]

The tableland Rhou-Arkh is buried in the verdure to the west of the continent, all covered in jungles and bogs. It is the motherland of orcs, poisonous snakes, man-eating flowers and other wondrous creatures. Here every step might turn out to be the last one and every breath – become a shout. Always be on guard and keep a sword at hand… better yet a flame-thrower. The main areas of unique interest are the giant statues of Swamp Monkeys erected in times immemorial by gods know whom. Orcs, naturally, claim them to be their doing, but it’s sufficient to have a look at the way the green-skinned build their huts or make pots, to completely share any doubts scholars have.

The Thorgor Range is situated in the north – it’s a mighty chain of mountains which has become home for a hardworking and venturous nation of dwarves. Here everywhere there are stone-pits, railway stations and mines; here unbidden guests are followed closely by the unblinking eyes of Granite Ancestors, and in dark caves ancient machines slumber, abandoned long ago. In the east Thorgor Range abuts against Tusky Gulf in streams of which the underground craftsmen and alchemists have dumped so many runoffs during the last centuries that even sea-gulls trouble to fly sideways.

Practically in the very heart of the continent there lies the grand wasteland Karraz-Ghul. Thousand years ago these plains were abundant with life; they were lands of magic and marvelous elven cities. But the civil war between the sorceresses of Fire and Ice not only put an end to the supremacy of the Firstborn but also turned a sometime fruitful land into a vast lifeless desert. Since then only ghosts and orc nomads dwell there, hordes of which during several centuries tormented realms of dwarves and people with constant raids.

One of the famous places in the desert is the Sandstorm Temple. Nobody knows precisely where it stands and even the most experienced nomad would not tell certain directions towards it. To find the way in one should pass through a special magical gateway. The mysterious disposition of the Temple gave birth to dozens of various theories, the most logical and reasonable one being the version scratched with a knife on a top of a table in the “Grey Basilisk” tavern. According to it the gateways take the one who dares to walk through not only across space but time as well. Supposedly, the Sandstorm Temple exists in future so distant that nothing alive abides there. Argus erected it as a memorial to the Four Nations and then he created portals so that the best representatives of these very nations could have the possibility to feast their eyes at the monument in their honour. But the mortals understood everything the wrong way, once again.

Regrettably, the author of this theory in unknown – during the night of its appearance in the “Grey Basilisk” several young Berserks stopped there and the innkeeper discovered the inscription only in the morning when he hammered together the tables. One of the guests although stated as if he had a chance to notice a stranger with a crutch who was carving enigmatic signs (apparently, the orc meant letters). According to him, the mysterious guest had two heads – but taking into consideration the fact that the Berserks had already managed to empty the wine vault of the tavern, this statement cannot be taken seriously, of course.

In the south the Ridge of Arganai borders Karraz-Ghul. Here among snowy peaks elven convents are hiding, where Sisters of Fire and Ice Witches serve apprenticeship. Reaching those legendary places is not easy: the secret paths are known only to a few ones and the sorceresses despise strangers. Depending on the way you’ve chosen, you can count only on a welcome either too warm or too cold. Although you will not enjoy the outcome at all accounts.

Practically nothing is known about the lands that stretch to the south. In older tomes they are named as Transridge and are described as covered by impenetrable forests hardly suitable for life. For instance, the well-known “Trampers’ Guide” recommends to all unfortunate that got there immediately to cover themselves with mud and hide in a secluded hollow. Also, captain Dolf the Dumb wrote in his memorandum about mosquitos the size of your fist and about a horrible fever which mowed two-thirds of his crew. Some stories are popular among common folks, in which Transridge sits for a forbidden land replete with monstrosities, treasures and warlocks. Rumor has it that people with hedgehog heads live there and giant crocodiles which speak only in iambic pentameter.

Nonetheless, the civilization penetrates gradually even to such distant corners. For example, on one of the islands of Ash-Grey Sea a bushranger Torwald Halfdead founded an academy of martial arts. It is situated amid the ruins of abandoned elven stronghold and is widely popular among the youngsters who dream of deeds of valour and glory. Frankly speaking, even getting there is quite an achievement fit for a couple of ballads.

Well, only one region is left to be described. North-east has once belonged to people. Here three mighty kingdoms gained ground, Free City of Isnar roared, unshakeable fortresses of Paladin Order towered above those lands. Now only flames reign there – the Outer Chaos unhurriedly but persistently sinks its teeth into the very materia of existence turning reality into some scorching primeval nought. The Rupture – a huge chasm stretching through the whole continent – serves as a sort of a border that doesn’t let the igneous ocean advance further to the west. But nobody has any doubts on account of that the Chaos once will pursue an offensive.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media.axd/281474976721401[/img]

notes.title: Update №36: Chimera's Awekening
notes.content:
[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd/281474976711219[/img]

The Update №36 has been successfully installed, "Chimera's Awakening" is already gaining momentum! The Faceless Goddess waits for you in her grim Throne Chamber. Set off on a long and dangerous journey through the brand new PvE map "Chimera Gardens".
 
Try Eternal Elixirs and unique decorative hats, enter into cooperation with a hireling who will level your characters while you are away. Discuss all that and many other new topics on the official forum, as usual - we are waiting for your feedback and opinions. The work is not over and the most interesting things are yet to come. Play PANZAR, friends!


    New PvE Map called “Chimera Gardens”.
    Game mode change for “Toxic Bay” map. The game mode is similar to the model of the map “Kromholm Mines”.
    In the shop you will find new items: “Eternal Potions” for 200 crystals each and a pack of three such potions for 420 crystals.
    New advertising added after matches.
    All transactions for Steam users will now be held in dollars.
    Friend referral system changed: If a friend invited by you purchases crystals, 25% of the amount will go to you too but not more than 50 crystals in total. Also removed the gold bonus for referral’s leveling up.
    Changes to the after match reward window: Now rewards possible to achieve with VIP account and appearances are included in the list.
    New custom hats for Inquisitor
    New custom hats for Frost Witch
    New custom hats for Sister of Fire
    New custom hats for Tank
    New custom hat for Gunner
    New custom hats for Sapper
    The system of hirelings added: Hireling works to earn experience and resources while you're offline. The time only counts down when the user is offline. The cost of a Hireling is equal to the cost of VIP account.
    In the shop there is a preview of gear. When you point at the gear you will see how the item will look like on your character.
    In your friends list the indicator of your friend playing other character has changed, now you will also see what character he is playing.
    The effectiveness indicator has appeared: it will compare your effectiveness with the effectiveness of all characters of your class and level.
    When a dwarf makes a required number of hits during the building of his constructions, the yellow sign of gears will appear.
    Sapper Teleport: Now occupies one slot instead of two on the skill bar. When you activate the ability a small menu will open where you must choose what to build: input or output. This is done in anticipation of new abilities in Patch 37.
    Mortar: Also now have ammo, 15 rounds, and the price in class points has been reduced by 50%. 75 CP now
    Building Golem: Now restores barrels and mortar rounds. The cost of the golem has not changed
    Barrel Swap: The barrels now have limited ammo, 50 rounds. The ability class point cost reduced by 50%. 40 CP now
    Sacrifice: Now it’s able to use on enemies, not allies. The principle of operation has not changed. When the character under Sacrifice buff dies, the healing buff zone appears.
    Purification: Purification now dispels the inquisitor cage. There is still a bug: logically cage falls off, but remains visual on the character (as with mortar), this will be fixed in Patch 37.
    Magic Silence: Now takes as much manna as lacking in your manna pool. If you have full manna it will stop draining manna from enemy
    Fixed many bugs on maps, as well as unbalanced places for dwarf turrets
    Repaired bug due to which at the start of the fight with pressed WASD and sprint after sprint push-ups, the character did not move
    Repaired the doubled accumulation of Class Points from two different totems for sappers
    Battering Ram and Vortex of War are not affected by a roughness of surface

notes.title: HALLOWEEN
notes.content:
Panzarians,

[img]http://www.panzar.com/_media.axd/281474976711206[/img]


Well, we can't ignore its autumn any longer – October is coming to its end, and it means that one of the most important holidays in the cruel and spooky PANZAR world is about to begin. 

Halloween, ladies and gentlemen! It's time to take your brooms and blood-stained masks from a closet, to dust off ancient witchcraft, tombes and rehearse some evil laughter in front of a mirror. In the game everything is ready for the annual dark carnival. 

The Main Menu was decorated for the upcoming Halloween holidays. Two new items have appeared in the game – [b]"Ghost"[/b] and [b]"Candy"[/b] – which can be used for crafting fancy headwear. There are four types of headwear: [b]Pumpkin Mask, Hideous Sack, Witch Hat and Evil Cap[/b]. Three holiday maps were added: [b]Flight from the Spooky Fort, Night of Infernal Farmers and Station of Lost Souls[/b]. 


Beware the strangers – especially if they have pumpkins on their shoulders – and play PANZAR!

notes.title: Epic Winners, Zar salute you!
notes.content:
It has been an epic week of events! It was the final of the PvE challenge and there were not one, but two tournaments last night. Characters from level 10 all the way to mighty level 30 were out to play. They won loads of crystals.

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710883[/img]

Clan ArmadA literally owned the PvE challenge this week, stealing the top 3 spots of the PvE challenge on mode Very Hard. They rocked the challenge, finishing it in a record 38 minutes. And you can check out Team Taka's historic performance right here on this video. Trust us, Armada guys have some serious moves, there's some lessons to be learned here!

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710949[/img]

We launched the Varsity Tournaments this week. Every Thursday, players level 10-19 will fight in teams of 6 to win up to 666 crystals for their team! And here are our glorious winners this week:

1st: 666 crystals - [Lunastra] Angels of Death
2nd: 555 crystals - [KoloroweBolki] Bolki Alfa
3rd: 444 crystals (x2) [Erebor 1] War Master / [Fantastic Killer] TerroristKillers 

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710950[/img]

At the same time, our all star European players were fighting at the top for the right and respect to get a Gold League. Strange things have been happening during these tournaments, Gods of War are moving in on the resident superstar clans, ArmadA players are just giving away their crystals to competing players, Exclusive continue to deliver top quality gameplay and Lunastra are accumulating enemies with their plots to get ahead on the grid. This is how it finished last night:

1st: 4,000 crystals - [Exclusive] Family 
2nd: 3,000 crystals- [ArmadA] Robin Hood
3rd/4th: 2,500 - [Gods of War] Alleanza Bestial / [Exclusive] Progressif

notes.title: Item: Warboss Fur Cap (HD video)
notes.content:
It was noon in the Valley of the Red Stones, when the Berserkers struck a fancy for this new hat: the [b]Warboss Fur Cap[/b]. It is the height of Orc fashion, they say. As with the previous two headdresses, it is worn over any helmet and does not modify any characteristics of your favourite green-skinned killer.

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710937[/img]

Many years ago, there was an orc chieftain named Sarai Hlag Mawr, the Bad Head. He was [b]mighty and fearless[/b], but he had a problem - he had no fangs! That’s right, not one menacing fang jutted from his beastly mouth. To avenge the mockery he was the victim of, he sought a famous halfling healer who was rumoured to have a miracle cure for toothless Orcs. The Dwarves say they smeared his cheeks with strange ointments and his beard started to grow rapidly - and underneath it, the chieftain had such tusks that Zar himself was envious! Delighted, Hlag Maur bought three more boxes of this potion ... 

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710943[/img]

After this episode, the Orc chieftain became ill. His tribe, in anger, vowed to find this Dwarf healer and turn his head into a headdress. Thus began a new war (to be honest, by that time the old war was not quite finished) between the orcs and dwarves. These steppe savages quickly came to love these novel hats. Since then a lot has happened, and now you can see more and more Warboss Fur Caps from [b]fox and wolfskins[/b], but it still scares the pants off the Dwarves!

[b]Check out the headgear in HD [url=http://youtu.be/ukGN0avtEdM]here[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Item: Warboss Fur Cap (HD video)
notes.content:
It was noon in the Valley of the Red Stones, when the Berserkers struck a fancy for this new hat: the [b]Warboss Fur Cap[/b]. It is the height of Orc fashion, they say. As with the previous two headdresses, it is worn over any helmet and does not modify any characteristics of your favourite green-skinned killer.

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710937[/img]

Many years ago, there was an orc chieftain named Sarai Hlag Mawr, the Bad Head. He was [b]mighty and fearless[/b], but he had a problem - he had no fangs! That’s right, not one menacing fang jutted from his beastly mouth. To avenge the mockery he was the victim of, he sought a famous halfling healer who was rumoured to have a miracle cure for toothless Orcs. The Dwarves say they smeared his cheeks with strange ointments and his beard started to grow rapidly - and underneath it, the chieftain had such tusks that Zar himself was envious! Delighted, Hlag Maur bought three more boxes of this potion ... 

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710943[/img]

After this episode, the Orc chieftain became ill. His tribe, in anger, vowed to find this Dwarf healer and turn his head into a headdress. Thus began a new war (to be honest, by that time the old war was not quite finished) between the orcs and dwarves. These steppe savages quickly came to love these novel hats. Since then a lot has happened, and now you can see more and more Warboss Fur Caps from [b]fox and wolfskins[/b], but it still scares the pants off the Dwarves!

[b]Check out the headgear in HD [url=http://youtu.be/ukGN0avtEdM]here[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Important News: Runes
notes.content:
[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710941[/img]

Panzarians, we have some important information! As previously reported, the current rune system will be radically redesigned. We are replacing temporary runes and rune shards. Instead, you will get [b]permanent runes[/b], so you will no longer have to worry about them running out when you need them the most. But like any coin, there is a downside: all the old resources and items associated with the runes will be removed from the game with "Update 35." So now, it is time to use them or sell the surplus to the shop.

notes.title: Item: Fanged Helm (HD video)
notes.content:
You’ve seen our Old Shaman’s Cowl, now it’s time to discover the next item we have for the most charming and attractive PANZAR characters - the Berserker. In the jungle, as the Roux-Arkham sun sets, it’s time for some marshy romance. Have you ever wondered what’s the best way to conquer the Elven heart? The Orcs know: [b]the Fanged Helm![/b] 

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710935[/img]

It is widely accepted that, despite their brutal appearance and rough voices, deep in their bestial soul, Orcs are not immune to the beautiful, but destructive Elves. It is told that the great leader, [b]Maar-Zug the Wicked Leg, was devoured by passion for the Mother Superior of Frost Path Monastery.[/b] In order to impress this icy matriarch - he crafted a helmet from her beloved cat. But something went wrong: instead of passionate embraces, he got the steely cold of her deadly chakrams. The heartbroken Elf leader disposed of the smitten Orc before overdosing on energy elixirs… Sad indeed is this tale of love and loss...

[img]http://panzar.ru/_media.axd?id=281474976711013[/img]

Inspired by this sentimental drama, Orcs began forging themselves headgear from the jungle’s wild cats, selecting only the largest and most dangerous for their decorative fancy. Our beloved swamp-dwelling Berserkers know what is needed to claim the heart of these icy ladies: [b]‘Elf love cat, cat is cute - elf love orc if look like cat’.[/b] So if you have your heart set on some mystical damsel, dear Berserkers, you are going to need one of these!

[b]Check out the HD footage right [url=http://youtu.be/MsAh7QKkuuM]here[/url].[/b]
