notes.title: Item: Old Shaman's Cowl (HD video)
notes.content:
[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710930[/img]

[b]Are you unique?[/b] Do you want to stand out from the crowd? Well we do! Months have past and our Dwarven designers have been working away on ways to improve your character’s Fitting Room and they have succeeded. As their little fingers hammered away, their big brains churned so hard that even the frosty-eared Elves started to worry. Until one day, when an explosion of victorious hollars vibrated through the cavernous studio. 

They had found it, the ideal solution; well, at least until their next big idea. Between shouts of joy, they explained the plan: the races of PANZAR will get [b]decorative items[/b]. These items can be worn during battle but will not affect their armour. Interested? Read on! 

[img]http://panzar.ru/_media.axd?id=281474976711009[/img]

The first guinea pigs are the most gentle and innocent inhabitants of PANZAR - the[b] Berserkers.[/b] They are getting three unique headgear items including the most venerable and massive [b]Old Shaman’s Cowl[/b]. It lasts forever, can be put on or removed in the blink of an eye, does not modify character specs and will allow your tender Zerk to shine on the battlefield.

Shamans have a terrible lot of respect for these green-skinned swamp dwellers; they even think Orcs have supernatural abilities. Every real Berserker has a few of these artifacts somewhere; stolen from a hissing shaman shaking his dried frog legs. Sitting around the campfire in the evenings, they boast of how they overpowered the shaman to take his cowl. The Orcs have a simple motto: 

[b]" Wear the Old Shaman’s Cowl, respect yourself! "
[/b]

You can check out our HD video Berserker in the Old Shaman's Cowl [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uvPb-qr4Uz8]here[/url]. Like if you want more awesome headgear for your chars!

notes.title: Swamp Horror: Final PvE Brief
notes.content:
[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710911[/img]

You were looking for [b]adventure[/b], weren’t you? I know where to find it. Listen carefully because your whole life may depend on my words. Whatever happens now, we need a plan.

Zar’s second cousin’s grandnephew is now languishing in that cage up on the hill as you already know. Of course, you’ve heard - only the dead and the deaf have been saved the carnage of his brutal screams. Who knew that old hamadryad - [b]may Krom rip off his tusks![/b] – would be so angry at all this nonsense. In short, his army is heading this way, and, worse still, the batyrs, personal guards of Zar, are leading the charge. You know, the horned ones. Hey, somebody - silence that inquisitor and get him away from the door, it’s locked from the other side. My brave warriors, the only way is forward now - so here’s the plan.

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710916[/img]

First, the [b]good news[/b]. The fortress, though it was built by Orcs, has got excellent fortifications. That greatly improves our … I mean your ... chances of success. Enemies may be at the gates, but it’s a tighter spot, easier to defend.

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710919[/img]

Then, the local shaman have given us some sort of statue. That ugly idol. They say it’s an artifact, and that it will hide the presence of [b]Yordrag the Unwashed Horror[/b]. So let’s not break it, okay?!

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710918[/img]

Thirdly, Captain Nightmare, was called away on some terribly urgent matters. In such a hurry he forgot his [b]gun cargo[/b]. It should be set up in the canopy next to our caged guest. If he manages to break free or that idol doesn’t work, we fall back, to the heart of the fortress. Look around you, some of you might even survive.

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710921[/img]

And now for the [b]bad news[/b]. Local tribes have categorically refused to participate in the battle. They also do not want regular troops crossing their land. So the Conclave has given this matter to the mercenaries - us … well you, my brave champions. It’ll be time to set off soon. I wish you luck. [b]May the battle bring you mercy![/b]

[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710922[/img]

notes.title: Swamp Horror in New PvE
notes.content:
[IMG=http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710899][/IMG]

PANZAR PvE has now been here for a few months and the response has been awesome - with Panzarians demanding a new map and even [b]more evil bots[/b] to dominate. We totally agree and we put our hardworking office orcs to work immediately. They have been sleep-deprived and starved. We promised them salvation in exchange for finishing the project as fast as their fat little fingers can. And they nearly have! So if you want to find out [b]who will be the next boss[/b], keep reading!

[IMG=http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710905][/IMG]

As some secret sources may have revealed, the new location is set [b]in the jungle[/b]. Your aim is to protect the valuable living trophy in the cage on the point of Cannibal Stronghold. You would be wise not to let the prize out though, [b]terrible things happen[/b] when swamp monkeys are left to run wild! 

[IMG=http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710900][/IMG]

For the answer, we turned to the founders and ideologists of all PANZAR characters, Alexander [b]«the Manimator»[/b] Steshenko, who fed us some crumbs of wisdom. The inspiration for this character comes straight from one of his original works and somehow went on to keep most of his magical attributes as he evolved from paper to bot. From swamp monkey to boss, [b]Yordrag The Unwashed Horror[/b] is now one of the most aggressive and dangerous creatures of the dreamscape jungles. 

[IMG=http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710901][/IMG]

But where do these endless waves of hairy horror come from? This is what the [b]Kromholom Evening newspaper[/b] has to say.

[IMG=http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710906][/IMG]

Players, you have [strong]just a few more weeks[/strong] to wait. In the meantime, we are celebrating our first PvE map, Fire Cauldron Valley, with the awesome Weekly Challenge, where the fastest team wins 3,000 crystals! All the info is [url=http://forum.panzar.com/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=12861]here[/url].

notes.title: World Cup Event 06.07
notes.content:
[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710890[/img]

Lawlessness has taken over both on the pitch and in the arena. In Brazil, the [b]puny humans[/b] have dropped the ball and decided to bite each other instead of claiming glory and greatness. Looks like [b]PANZAR players need to teach them a lesson in real combat![/b]

Panzarians, band together in [b]the honour of a nation[/b]. Hoist their flag and defend their reputation. That’s right, on July 6, it will be Panzar’s first ever Dreamscape World Cup! 

So, in the spirit of sportsmanship and the love of chaos, get your level 30 character on a national team before all the goods one are gone!

[b]The Prizes:

1st place: 5,000
2nd place: 3,000
3rd/4th place: 2,000[/b]

No duplicate country names allowed. First come, first choice of country name. Get registered before [b]Sunday 6 July[/b]. The tournament will start at [b]20.00 CET[/b]. Our clan leaders will be talking nations on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/240320/discussions/0/522730700652148139/]forum[/url].

notes.title: Weekly PvE Challenge
notes.content:
[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710883[/img]


Panzarians, as you already know, we have a brand new PvE map coming soon. In the meantime, [b]let’s celebrate[/b] the first map with its trolls, pigs and angry War God Zar.

Every week, teams can [b]win up to 3,000 crystals in our PvE challenge[/b]. All you have to do is be the [b]fastest team to complete the map[/b] on a difficulty level our choice. 

[b]The prizes:[/b]

[b]1st place: 3,000 crystals
2nd place: 2,000 crystals
3rd place: 1,000 crystals[/b]

[b]What you have to do:
[/b]
Get into teams, [b]stream your PvE match[/b] and post it to the forum (details below). Every Tuesday we will watch and check your submissions. The 3 fastest teams will receive crystals. Please[b] read the rules[/b] and post all the information on the [b][url=http://forum.panzar.com]forum thread[/url][/b] (details below). Remember no stream or incomplete information, no crystals!

[b]The dates and levels:
[/b]
[b]Week 1: MEDIUM 25.06 - 01.07
Week 2: HARD 02.07 - 08.07
Week 3: VERY HARD 09-.07 - 15.07[/b]

[b]The rules:[/b]

You must stream and post the stream on our forum thread. This stream must show:
- difficulty mode selection at beginning (each week it will be different)
- player names at beginning of match*
- player names at end of match*

On your forum post, please include this information:
- link to stream
- start and end time of fastest battle streamed (just in case the stream has more than one battle)
- character names of team

*The team must have the same players at the start and end!

notes.content:

notes.title: PANZAR Trading Cards Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://panzar.com/_media.axd?id=281474976710866[/img]
Players, you can now collect your own set of PANZAR trading cards in Steam. Turn your experience in the Argus Dreamscape into badges and customise your profile. There are 8 cards to collect. Each one has a original artwork and tells the murky story of a dark creature from this world. Each full set of cards can be crafted into a badge - and each badge will get you an exclusive background and emoticon. In total, we have 10 backgrounds and 7 emoticons for the most dedicated of players - one of both is uncommon, and another one is totally rare! Every time you spend $9 or the currency equivalent on the game, you will receive 1 card. It’s that simple. Then you can trade them with friends to get the whole deck (x8). Start now and show your enemies and teammates who’s boss in PANZAR!

notes.content:

The winners will be selected by our awesome jury of PANZAR designers. notes.title: RISE of KROMHOLM: UPDATE #34
notes.content:
[img]https://production.panzar.com:444/API/WebMedia.ashx?mediaID=281474976710702&t=1401192680088&localeID=2[/img]

It's that time of the month Panzarians! Yes, it's true, on Tuesday morning, we gave you [b]Update 34[/b]. Now it’s time to log back in and update your game client. 

Hurry up and get on there if you want to be among the first on our long-awaited [b]new PvP map: Mines of Kromholm![/b] The age of the Dwarves has indeed returned to Panzar and now you can try out your battle skills deep in the heart of the mountains. It’s a new hybrid mode for PANZAR, a cross between “King of the Hill” and “Mechanism”. It starts off right in the Central Hall of Kromholm, located between team spawn points. Once it has been captured, the mechanism magics itself away to one of the seven other spots on the map.

Don’t let the deep labyrinths and majestic Dwarven carvings distract you or you might never get out! If you do survive, then come to the forum and ruin the surprise for all those who haven’t updated yet.

Check out our [b]patch notes [url=http://www.panzar.com/en/rnotes/]here[/url][/b]

notes.title: 666 Tournament, lvl 10 - 20, starts Thursday, 29 May
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_033.jpg[/img]

Relax! The [b]«6.6.6. Tournament»[/b] has nothing to do with the infamous number of the Beast or any other satanic mysteries - because there is no Satan in the universe of Panzar! We do have some unpleasant deities but they mostly don’t give a crap about numbers or beasts. In the Argus dreamscape, there is only one who can count, add and multiply, it’s Krom!



It was he who once decided that three wreathen sixes would make a great tattoo right above his… well, above his… okay, it almost impossible to pronounce or spell in English, so let’s just try to preserve our sanity and continue with the story.



Krom has been very pleased with the tattoo ever since and as soon as he heard about the rules of prepared tournament he immediately contacted us offering the title and the explicit photo of his… ahem… of his tattoo as a coat of arms for the event.



We were reluctant to accept the title - Krom can be strange and unbearable at times but he is still a god, you know! However, it turned out to be absolutely impossible to work with The Photo as every individual who tried became immediately and totally demented. Spittle, snivel, gabbling and mad laughter. So In order to save the studio staff, we hired a couple of occult detectives and those guys burnt a computer with That Photo.



Now imagine how lucky you are! You have a fantastic opportunity to participate in the «6.6.6. Tournament» created by Krom himself - and without any danger for your mind. Isn’t it marvelous?!



The 6.6.6. Tournament is reserved for teams of [b]6 players from level 10-20[/b]. It will run for 3 weeks and the best overall team will also [b]win 1 week premium[/b] for its 6 participants. Every week, top teams will be able to win these prizes:



[b]1st place: 666 crystals

2nd place: 555 crystals

3rd/4th place: 444 crystals[/b]



The first 6.6.6. Tournament starts on [b]Thursday, May 29th at 20.00 CET.[/b] Don’t forget [b]registrations close at 16.00 CET[/b] on the day of the event! Recruit players right here on our [url=http://www.panzar.com/forum/]forum[/url].

notes.title: Mayhem Returns Tournament 22.05
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_036.jpg[/img]

[b]Mayhem Returns[/b] for all the top players! Registrations are open and it's time to show Zar who's boss. He was unseasonally generous in the last tournament and turned a blind eye to tournament rule offenses - but no more! 



The top teams will continue to fight it out for a place in the sun and a [b]bountiful crystal booty[/b]. First place will give players a handsome 4,000 crystals to divide between themselves. Second place grabs them a decent 3,000 and even the third and fourth teams are treated to 2,500 crystals each. Not to mention that Panzar is just giving away 1,000 crystals to one random losing team.



Mayhem Returns Tournament is on [b]Thursday 22.05 at 20.00 CET[/b]. Register your teams before 16.00 on the same day to get a fighting chance at free crystals! You can even find a clan or battle buddies on the forum!

notes.title: Final Spring Tournament Winners and Streams
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_17.jpg[/img]

That's it. Spring is quickly being overcome by summer. It is only right that the [b]Spring Tournaments[/b] should be replaced too - and so, it is with great pleasure and regret that we, the whole [b]Panzar Crew, congratulate the winners[/b] of this final round.



[b][Exclusive] Family[/b] came up from behind and sneakily dethroned the unbeatable Armada Clan to claim 4,000 crystals. [b][Armada] Happy Bunnies[/b] clenched the 3,000 crystals for second place, while [b][Lunastra][/b] colonised the third and fourth spots with teams [b]Mortar Combat[/b] and [b]Nemesis[/b]. They both got 2,500 crystals for their efforts.



So now Panzarians, all you can do is wait, until we reveal the next [b]new tournament[/b] for Europe. Registrations will open on Tuesday 13.05 with the new structure. You can get all the matches thanks to our Euro mods stream [url=http://www.panzar.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=12666]here[/url].



Don't forget, Russia is on [b]holidays (09.05 - 11.05)[/b] - so as sad as we all are to be [b]out of the office[/b], we will only be available in case of emergency!

notes.title: SERVER MAINTENANCE moved to 07.05 - patch 33.7
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_030.jpg[/img]


It's time to update our servers Panzarians. Tomorrow we will go offline at 06.00 CET to bring the game up to speed with its future. We hope you will be patient with our hardworking office orcs who will be sweating over our motherboards. Don't worry though, the recovery should be speedy!



And when it's over, you can expect:



- Changes to Premium Accounts
- Changes to Battle Value - no longer dependent on number of skills learned
- Character level has higher influence on BV. 
- Items, amulets and upgrades have less influence on BV.
- Following these important changes to BV, all characters baseline values are reset.



So head to our [url=www.panzar.com/forum/]forum[/url] to take a potshot or a lucky guess at what we have coming!

notes.title: GREAT RACE TOURNY WINNERS WITH QPAD
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_018.jpg[/img]

According to ancient Elven tradition, each newly-elected Mother-Prioress of every monastery must marry – and during each wedding, there is a contest opposing great mages and warriors. However, the many cataclysms of PANZAR had left the world destitute of worthy male Elves. That’s why the Two-Headed God created the Great Race Tournament.



It was a fierce battle, overspilling with psychological trauma, shocking events and u-turns. Expectations were both met and destroyed. The Races overcame their clan affinities to prove their utmost worth.



The Elves came, conquered and claimed the awesome Qpad OM-75 mice and the ultra-exclusive mouse pads. The Dwarves forfeited in battle and the Orcs fell to pieces. The stealthy Humans infiltrated the gaps to take second place, staking their right to the remaining ultra-original Panzar artwork by QPAD.



Panzar Studios congratulates all those amazing characters who took fate into their hands and believed in their classes enough to fight to the death for victory! And you can catch every second, or nearly, of these amazing battles on our [url=http://www.panzar.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=5&t=12619]youtube channel[/url]  thanks to our Panzarians Pin Pon Pin (Gunner), Chibobo (Paladin) and White Wolfs (Inquisitor) for their help streaming this great event.



[i]Winners must send NAME - ADDRESS (incl. postcode + country) - TEL NUMBER to community_eu@panzar.com if they want to receive thier prize(s)[/i]

notes.title: New Map with Update 34
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_028.jpg[/img]

Update #34 is simmering on the fires of chaos and the Studios are preparing a brand new map for our Panzarians. This time, we are heading into the earthy caves of the underground dwelling Dwarves, with our brand new “King of the Hill” mode.  
 
We like to keep it fresh! Last update, we brought you PvE mode and a brand new map. This time we are offering you a totally new PANZAR experience in the dark, enclosed caverns of this vertically-challenged race. You are going to get the chance to test one of our hopefully more brilliant ideas - and if you like it enough, we might even consider renovating ‘Toxic Bay’ too. 


[img]http://www.panzar.ru/images/gallery/DwarfUndergrounds_09.jpg[/img]

“Mines of Kromholm” will give Panzarians a chance to fight it out on 3 murky underground levels deep in the heart of the mountain where hides the mother of invention. Take a second to admire the granite stairs, majestic bridges, wacky creations, unbreakable columns and artful transport systems in the calm before the storm.

The new mode is more of a fusion between our existing " King of the Hill " and " Mechanism ". It all starts in the center of the Great Hall , located equidistantly from the two opposing teams. As the match progresses, the mechanism will be randomly transferred to another one of the seven points on the map. Teams and players must be ready to react, but fear not, loud sirens will wail the alert when it’s time to move on, but not until one of the teams gains the upper hand in the bloody carnage there first. 

[img]http://www.panzar.ru/images/gallery/DwarfUndergrounds_03.jpg[/img]

The mechanism will be subjected to several dynamic changes in a few different places in order to get the team from the start location to the point of interest within the same period of time. By the way, it will take a little longer for the team that owns the point than the attackers, because defending is a little easier. First team to 500 points will be declared victorious.

In the meantime, you can stave off the impatience on the forum, where we have put most of the patch notes already.

[img]http://www.panzar.ru/images/gallery/DwarfUndergrounds_11.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Epics Preview - Part 2
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_022.jpg[/img]

Now that we have unveiled at least some of the coming epics, it’s time to answer some of those more technical questions the top Panzarians have been asking us!

[b]Q: If I have an epic in the inventory,  but I decide to use my usual 30 weapons on my character, will the experience accumulate for my epic anyway ?[/b]

A:: No, your Epic will only acquire experience and evolve through its 4 stages if you are using it in battle.


[b]Q: How many victories are needed to get the next stage of the epic? Will I be able to see my progress?[/b]

A: Yes, you can see the progress, as well as how much is left to the next level of evolution. When you get the required number of points , the weapon will automatically evolve. Actually, we are currently trying to decide if we should remove progress points for deliberate out-of-combat use of the epic weapon. We’ll let you know how that goes!


[b]Q: What about the epic’s characteristics? What will happen when I upgrade it in the Forge?[/b]

A: As with any other epic item, the new weapons differ from their conventional counterparts by 10%. Upgrades work in the exactly the same as on conventional weapons.

But enough with the words. Take a look instead!

[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/EpicWeapons_Bers_600.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/EpicWeapons_Tank_600.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Epics Preview - Part 1
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_021.jpg[/img]

PANZAR has lined up some [b]ultimate Epic weapons[/b] for our players. Some lucky Panzarians have already caught a glimpse of these mythical mouldings of power, and for the others, it’s finally time to see what they look like. 
 
These Epics are exclusively reserved for the elite of the Argus dreamscape. They differ from normal weapons by their [b]increased performance and sleek appearance[/b]. These upcoming releases will have four stages of evolution, but don’t be fooled, even the first is enough to inflict mortal damage on your opponents.
 

[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/EpicWeapons_Ink_600.jpg[/img]


To upgrade these weapons, there is no easy path. The Panzarian will have to fight and accumulate experience through the blood of those before them.

But what you all really want to know... Yes! The air is vibrating with your unformulated question:  ‘When?’. Earlier rumours are, and it is our greatest regret to inform you, not correct. These weapons will not be released with Update 34, but a little later in the [b]future of PANZAR[/b]. In the meantime, we may have a few new maps to keep you occupied though.

So keep an eye on the news, we will be releasing some epic pics of these new weapons over the next few weeks. This topic is definitely going to be hot on our forum, so let us know what you think [url=www.panzar.com/forum/]here[/url]!


[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/EpicWeapons_Pal_600.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Great Race Tournament
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_018.jpg[/img]


According to ancient Elven tradition, each newly-elected Mother-Prioress of every monastery must marry – and during each wedding, there is a [b]contest opposing great mages and warriors.[/b] However, the many cataclysms of PANZAR had left the world destitute of worthy male Elves.  




That’s why the Two-Headed God created the [b]Great Race Tournament.[/b] Here, the best warriors of all nations can try themselves against each other to decide who is indeed the worthiest and most decent race of all PANZAR. The Great Race Tournament is [b]Sunday, April 27 at 18:00 CET.[b]



But first, the teams of each race will confront each other in a Qualifying Tournament. Teams of Elves will fight Elves, Orcs against Orcs, Dwarves with Dwarves and Men versus Men. Only the best of each team will get the chance to participate in the Great Race Tournament. The [b]Qualifying Tournament is Thursday, April 24 at 20:00 CET.[/b]



First and second place teams will all win totally [b]exclusive QPAD CT Mouse Pads[/b] with [b]unique Panzar artwork (x20)[/b]. The winning team will also get a [b]QPAD OM-75 Mouse each (x10).[/b] These mice are designed for professional gamers with high speed tracking and an 5 programmable shortcut buttons.


Head to the [url=www.panzar.com/fprum]forum[/url] to find a team, or find your team mates on our Global Chat in the game client.

[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_17.jpg[/img]

The first round of the Spring Tournament has already past but there was not a rusty sword among the participants who made it through the hardest part - our tournament system. The teams compliant with the rules and regulations battled hard and valiantly. And this is who and what they won:
 
1st place: HappyBunnies [ArmadA]
2nd place: Harlequin [WarriorRage]
3rd/4th place: Friends and Co [Anthares] - Predators [Gods of War]
 
Congratulations!!
 
All the remaining qualifying teams were thrown into a big pot. Then our European CM, Queen Bee, selected one random team from them to get 1,000 crystal participation prize during her [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IQjlAbWJ-pU&feature=youtu.be]Live Stream[/url]. That’s right, sometimes, it isn’t just about winning, it’s about participating. 

And the winner is: [Zabijam bo lubie] LORDofWAR

So Team Captain, email tournament_eu@panzar.com with the crystal distribution between the players!

Head to our [url=www.panzar.com/forum/]forum[/url] for the latest on the live stream and our great competitions.

notes.title: TECHNICAL SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.content: Important technical announcement for 32bit OS users. In order to maintain game client stability, we recommend players not to run Panzar in “Maximum Quality” graphic settings. 64bit OS users with less than 4GB RAM are recommended to reduce graphic settings from maximum. You can do this in the launcher window from the top left hand corner.

notes.title: Win Plantronics Gear
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_16eng.jpg[/img]

New update – new competition! Panzar Studio has joined forces with Plantronics, a leading producer of top quality headphones. From today (March 24th) until April 14th, collect special resources after every battle drop and forge them into your own lucky tickets to win one of the amazing prizes.
 
There are three resources available: The Unconquerable Headphones, Jack-The-Plugger and The Rogue Microphone. Craft them into one and they become ‘The Ticket’. Your lucky tickets will give you the chance to win one of many awesome Plantronics tech: GameCom 780 Headphones (x6), GameCom 380 Headphones (x6) or GameCom 307 Headphones (x3). There is no limit to the number of tickets you can forge - and don’t forget, the more tickets you craft, the higher your chances of winning!
 
Head over to our [url=http://www.panzar.com/plantronics/]special page[/url] to get all the info on these headsets and read our [url=http://www.panzar.com/contestrules/index_en.html]contest rules[/url]. Who knows, they could be yours very soon!

notes.title: Euro Spring Tournament starts Thursday @ 20.00
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_17.jpg[/img]

Tournament season is open again. It's time to climb out of your dusty cellars and greet the godly dawn with some sticky bloodshed. Spring cleaning awaits you as swarthes of opponents sharpen their blades in greeting. So get your team registered and ready for battle. It starts this Thursday at 20.00 CET. 
 
What's different?
 The rules have been modified ... Panzar will disqualify any winning team that has used an account who started the match with another TEAM. For more info, check out our rule changes  here.
 
And the prizes?
1st place: 4,000 crystals
2nd place: 3,000 crystals
3rd/4th place: 2,500 crystals each.
 
+ 1,000 crystals to a random team from the participants that did not win. The team will be randomly selected and announced during our weekly Live Stream. 
 
Registrations are open from Tuesday morning until Thursday 16.00 CET. All players from level 20-30 can participate if they have a team. Get registered and go claim your crystals. Or find a clan on our [url=www.panzar.com/forum/] European forum[/url].

notes.title: PvE is OUT
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_010.jpg[/img]
Another front has been opened on the Argus dreamscape. Players now have the chance to face the bots of Panzar on our brand-spanking new PvE mode. Play with strangers or with your friends, it won’t change the blood thirst of the boars heading straight for you. Not to mention the swamps, jungles, pigs, trolls and kamikaze gremlins who are all out to eradicate you. Choose from four different levels of difficulty and fight your way all the way to the feet of Zar in “Fire Cauldron Valley”. Not everybody will be up to the task and not everybody will survive. Will you be the first to finish our PVE mode? Tell what you think on our forum.

notes.title: SERVER MAINTENANCE 24.03.2014
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_015.jpg[/img]
Panzarians, our servers will be down for maintenance on Monday, March 24th. The crew apologises for this temporary inconvenience which last up to 6 hours. Our office orcs will start work at 05.00 CET until bloodied fingers and teary eyes to get everything back up and running for you as soon as possible. So if you can't log onto Panzar on Monday, don't worry, nothing is broken - we're making it better! Hang tight, because we can't wait to see you back in battle! Enjoy the video because the dream is about to come true, just a few more days. And to keep you on your toes, you can check out the patch notes right here.
You have just a few more days to wait before the dream comes true. And to keep you on your toes, you can check out the patch notes right here.
PATCH NOTE
[b]General Changes:[/b] 1. New game mode: PvE - (player versus computer bots). Game mode details: - 4 difficulty levels to choose from; - Solo and Teams modes with max 6 players (in PvP, groups are still limited to 3 players); - Classes subject to same restrictions as PvP mode (max. number of classes per match). 2. Improved After Battle Statistics. 3. Battle Value (effectiveness) of a character now displayed in the game menu and in game stats menu during a battle. 4. Killcam: follow your allies while waiting for respawn. 5. New animation for Victory and Defeat. 6. Tutorial videos now available for all Altar skills, Forge and Item Upgrades in the corresponding game tabs. 7. Forge: Armour organised by type. 8. Shop: equipment parts once again available for purchase in the Armour section. 9. Game client alerts players to newly available items in the Forge and Shop. 10. All armour organised by level: Light, Medium, Heavy. 11. New Forge mechanics. Crafting armour is dependent on achieving the previous level. For example, players cannot craft Heavy Pauldrons until they have crafted Medium Pauldrons. 12. Improved game balance. 13. Modified Battle Value impact. Player’s rankings are more stable. 14. Inquisitor and Gunner classes are now restricted. Players must have at least one level 5 character to unlock Gunner and Inquisitor classes. 15. Game Client optimisation: significantly less unplanned game closures. 16. Crystals will no longer be received for levelling up. 17. Resources cannot be bought with crystals. 18. ”Hall of Our Fathers” location has been redesigned. 19. Arquebus has been removed for levels 4,7,14,17,24,27. - If the character has this equipment (levels 4,7,14,17,24,27) when the game is updated, he will automatically receive the next level of Arquebus that he can use immediately. - If a player is crafting an Arquebus of these levels when this option is deleted, the crafting process will be stopped. All resources used in the crafting process will be turned into Mythic Stones. 20. Dwarf sets are cheaper. 21. Individual items for Dwarves are a bit more expensive. 22. Mythic stones can be exchanged for ingredients to make potions. [b]Changes to Game Balance:[/b] 1. Gunner: “Beacon” skill. The turret travels faster (2 secs, down from 3 secs). The appearance mechanics have been changed. The player teleporting the turret will be moved backwards if he stands on the beacon. 2. Paladin: “Sacrifice” radius increased to affect all skill levels within 15 metres range (before the effect was limited to 6 - 11m range). 3. Paladin: “Purification” effect radius increased to 17 metres (from 15m). 4. Capture time on the 5th point of “Dwarven Quarry” increased by 5 seconds. 5. Recovery times increased for the following skills: - from 10 to 20 seconds: Berserker “Vortex of War”; - from 10 to 16 seconds: Inquisitor “Fetters”; - from 10 to 29 seconds: Paladin “Ring of Immortality”; - from 10 to 20 seconds: Sister of Fire “Skyfire”; - from 20 to 35 seconds: Tank “Invincibility”; - from 5 to 11 seconds: Frost Witch “Instant Freeze”. 6. Third phase of second capture point was removed at “Cursed Shrine” map. [b]Bugs and Error Corrections:[/b] 1. Berserker cannot jump with meteor or mechanism in hands. 2. No buff icons for cannons level 1 to 5. 3. Fixed error when taking screenshots with Win32. 4. Fixed error causing crashes when exchanging resources with Win32. 5. Player ranking (after group disbands) is now correctly updated in the Social tab. 6. There was a bug, when Tank under Paladin Powder buff regained stamina while holding block. Tank no longer replenishes energy from Paladin powders when blocking. 7. No longer possible to access the mechanism from under the pier in “Toxic Bay”. 8. Animation of LMB (Left Mouse Button) attacks of Berserk after Combat Jump corrected. 9. Fixed error stopping player from taking the meteor if he is at the gate and the meteor is lying outside the gate. 10. No-build zone extended on the rock next to first capture point on thе “Elven Pier” map. 11. Fixed error causing character to die when jumping through gate of “Meteor Hunt” map. 12. Fixed error allowing Gunners get under the textures using cannon and two teslas. 13. Fixed error causing game freeze when updating tournament table. [b]Thank you![/b] Everything we have achieved with this patch could not have been done without the help of our awesome players. They actively participated in the testing stage and even found the time to locate a number of errors in our game client. And these players are (in no particular order): HUNHammer, Snookeh, Tephis, Karioka, DeadIsPeace, iEagleJim, Curical, Algatzar, Svet-Angle, Melissa-aK and White Wolf.

notes.title: Update 33: Learn Panzar Basics
notes.content:
<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_009.jpg[/img]<center>

The merge is here and has unleashed happy linguistic chaos on the adrenaline packed battles with ultra rapid match-making mechanics. Not to mention the level cap, which opens up the new whole new world of level 30 to Panzarians: that’s 10 new levels, new Epics, extra Amulet slots and new Skills.
 
As we open our eyes to the brand new Panzar world, it’s time to discover what will be coming up in the next patch, creatively called “Update 33”. 
 
SKILLS VIDEOS

We have heard that Panzar game mechanics are difficult to understand for new players. This patch is going to change this. We are making tutorial videos that show you exactly what your character can do. These videos can be watched in the Panzar game client. They will show you exactly what each skill looks like and what it’s for. With this information, players can make the right decision when spending their precious Skill Points at the Panzar Altar.

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/4zWE8HKuoVE" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe><center>

 
UPGRADES

And the Panzarians chanted: “We want a confirmation box before we upgrade.” When our players demand, we listen. No more 0.1 point upgrades. We got it. With “Update 33”, there will be no more finger slips or mistakes, the Panzar game client will ask you to accept your upgrade in a special confirmation box before anything is changed. 

<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/5.jpg[/img]

THE FORGE

Yes. We like to improve Panzar’s Forge. Every patch makes the crafting system a little bit different and a little bit better: perfection is 99% effort and only 1% luck. We have a different Recipe List. It will no longer appear in blocks organised by level. Instead you will have a list of everything you can craft at that moment from weapons to armour. New players can even watch a video tutorial, they just have to click on the button. You can see some screenshots of the new Forge below. 


<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/4.jpg[/img]<center>


<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/3.jpg[/img]<center>

Head to our [url=http://www.panzar.com/forum/]forum[/url]where nothing is taboo. Tell us what you like. Tell us what you want. You demand. We listen. It’s all here.

notes.title: Update 33: The Killcam Afterlife
notes.content:
<center>[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_008.jpg[/img]<center>

Our “Update 33” saga continues here! Next up on our innovation list is the…
 
KILLCAM
The KillCam is what you see when you die. Until now, Panzarians watched their dead character lie on the battle ground. Their corpses were beaten, kicked and moved by the surviving warriors. You waited for respawn. We said: “No More!”. 
 
FOLLOW THE BATTLE
With our new Update 33, you can unstick the camera from your character and follow a living teammate and see the battle through his eyes. We are sure this will appeal to our tournament and clan players.
 
FOR PvE
And it’s not only for PvP - it may be extra important for our upcoming PvE mode. In this game mode, death may last up to 90 secs if no one resurrects you. So if you’re dead and waiting, you can use the KillCam to help your living teammates coordinate their strategy. And this is how it will look:

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/WawVya16-IQ" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

We have some great other visuals for you too. For example, instead of a boring “Victory” screen (or even worse “Defeat”), you will get an animated result announcement instead - like this, just in your language: 

<center><iframe width="560" height="315" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/Sh2yktjS-m8" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe><center>

Head to our forum where nothing is taboo. Tell us what you like. Tell us what you want. You demand. We listen. It’s all here.

notes.title: Update 33: What is Battle Value?
notes.content:
[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/lnc_007.jpg[/img]

Panzarians of our international servers, Panzarians who watch our Friday Live Streams, Panzarians who read the forum - you may already know what’s coming with Update 33. For all the others, you can read this blog for all the inside info.
 
BATTLE VALUE
 
Let’s start at the beginning: Battle Value. This is a fundamental element of balance and match-making. It is what decides who you play with in public matches and explains why a level 15 player can play with/against level 21. Actually level isn’t that important, but a whole lot of things are.
 
BV MATHS & BALANCE
 
What makes your Battle Value? The BV is calculated using your level, equipment (armour, weapons, runes, upgrades), player rating (matches lost/won/etc.) as well as your character skills and abilities. The total of all these numbers is your Battle Value. The maths are simple: the better you play, the better your stuff, etc. - the higher your BV. This is why you play in battles with people of a higher level. It’s also why some fully geared max level players (especially now match-making is improved) are fighting lower level players.
 
SHOW ME THE BV
 
“Level 20 against level 12. There’s no game balance. Booo. Panzar needs better balance mechanics.” We’ve all heard it - we’ve all read it - and we, the Panzar Crew, totally disagree. This is why “Update 33” has a new Battle Table after each match. It will show you your BV and all the other players too. You deserve to see your battle value, and you will. It will look something like this:

[img]http://www.panzar.com/images/gallery/BV03.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Winter Epic Armor Collection - Sisters Of Fire
notes.content: Ladies & gentlemen, pleeeease welcome – the [b]Winter Epic Armor Collection[/b]! With these frosty December days, you need some hot gear to keep that blood flowing. So please feast your eyes on our [b]Sister Of Fire[/b] today. [b]The Burning Dragonfly Masque[/b] is not just a piece of decorative art, it's an integral part of Elven history. The legendary band of war, the “Burning Dragonflies”, united the mightiest sorceresses of its time, only to be defeated in a terrible uphill battle near the The Red Stones Valley. In honour of their kin, Sisters Of Fire mastered battle magic giving them powers to forge special masks of gold and rubies.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Panzar
notes.content:
Panzar is Now Available on Steam!
This Free to Play is set in a world surrounded by the flowing oceans of Chaos, four ancient races fight in the name of cruel gods. Amid the grim remains of dead civilizations, their last and only reason for being is the thrill of combat and the lust for war. The only important traits are the ability to swing a sword, bash enemies with war hammers and decimating foes with devastating magical spells.

Show your valor in exciting battles, join a clan or collect enchanted artifacts, move from victory to victory, building up your might and improving your combat skills. Rise from the ranks and inscribe your name through the chronicles of fire and bloodstained steel!
